body.text: Begin reconstruction of all 315 frames using known 65 mm ball scale, SAM3 masks, a gravity-constrained spherical track, HaWoR initialization and the required MANO fitting method. Three tosses and interleaved in-hand spins are the task; quantitative ball rotation is unobservable.

After reconstruction is recorded, test a closed-loop residual neural policy trained by PPO around the reconstructed wrist reference. Use real ball-hand collision dynamics with no ball attachment or external object force. Curriculum begins with retention/capture before the full ordered task; report privileged object-state sensing and every evaluated checkpoint honestly.

body.summary: 315-frame tennis reconstruction: known-radius sphere, raw gravity 9.36–9.61 m/s², HaWoR + supervised MANO. Quality overall pass; format VALID. Focal prior, unobservable spin and residual contact/self-intersection warnings remain.

body.text: Prepare simulation v2: preserve robot/object physics and the recorded criteria, increase the policy finger-target filter from 2 to 6 rad/s (still below hardware joint speeds), widen finger residuals, and smooth residual actions over time. body.reflection: First PPO run established stable initial retention and wrist imitation but no qualifying toss. 0/20 full-task successes; one seed exceeded a finger speed limit and is a failure. Conservative finger target filtering and high-variance residual exploration limited release/launch learning. Next iteration uses smoother exploration, broader/faster finger residuals, stronger ball reward and scaled PPO returns in separately recorded simulation v2.

algorithm.curriculum: updates 0-9: initial hold .9s; 10-39: first-toss [redacted].15-2.65s; 40-99: 40% full episodes and local phases 1.15,2.5,4.9,6.15,7.5 with probabilities .15,.1,.15,.1,.1 for up to 2s; >=100: full episodes only.
algorithm.randomization: Mass uniform [.95,1.05], ball sliding friction uniform [.9,1.1] nominal; position +/-2mm XY +/-1mm Z; random orientation; encoder noise spec.
algorithm.exploration: Initial log std -2.2, temporal lowpass .25 new + .75 previous in policy command filter
algorithm.reward: Same dense terms as iteration 2 plus ordered task progression: 80 toss,120 catch,80 relative spin,150 final hold; 8 times new peak flight rise and 3 times spin angle potential difference. Exact state-machine thresholds match criteria v1; source retained.
algorithm.base_controller: Same base controller as sim v3; no physics change.

reward.contact: .5 when held phase and actual contact
reward.spin: 2 clipped relative angular velocity along palm normal /8 during spin windows
reward.launch: 2 clipped positive vertical ball velocity /2 within .12s of demonstrated launches
reward.separation: .5 for no hand contact inside demonstrated flight window
reward.failure: -50 on strict hardware terminal or ball loss
reward.ppo_scaling: Multiply total by .05 for optimization; CSV reward is scaled; term columns are unscaled physical reward terms
reward.task_progress: 80 qualifying toss,120 stable catch,80 relative spin,150 final hold in order; 8 times new peak flight rise and 3 times signed spin-angle potential difference. Hidden reward state uses criteria v1 thresholds, not an actor input.

domain_randomization.quantity: ball mass and shell inertia multiplier

curriculum.description: updates 0-9: initial hold .9s; 10-39: first-toss [redacted].15-2.65s; 40-99: 40% full episodes and local phases 1.15,2.5,4.9,6.15,7.5 with probabilities .15,.1,.15,.1,.1 for up to 2s; >=100: full episodes only.

training_curves.meaning: One row per vector environment step (16 independent environments); each reward term averaged over that batch; episode statistics populated on terminal steps; rounded to six significant digits to respect upload size; full precision retained locally.

policy.closed_loop: RL actor observes encoder noise, actual wrist state and privileged ball state every 20ms. Network residual is added to the recorded anatomical/wrist reference, then executed by 500Hz commands and 1kHz hardware PD. No object action, attachment or ball reset after initial state.
policy.sensor_limitation: Exact simulator object pose/velocity; no tactile/force/current input.

body.reflection: Ordered-stage bonuses increase mean partial progress to 1.50 tosses,0.95 catches,0.75 spins; one episode reaches three tosses/two catches/two spins. Full success remains 0/20; three finger-speed failures and only 12/20 wrist-similarity passes prevent claiming task reproduction. A 30-episode analysis of palm uprighting worsens first catching and is rejected. Continue from this checkpoint with stronger wrist tracking and terminal failure costs using full-episode RL; no criteria revision.

body.reflection: Correcting dense reward units and revisiting later-phase curricula still does not reproduce the complete skill in 20 fixed episodes. Report all stage counts, hardware and wrist failures; do not promote training reward or survival into success. Across seven RL iterations the strongest evidence is partial toss/catch/turn sequences. Remaining work is reliable in-hand turning and composing all three catches while preserving wrist similarity. All criteria remain v1 and all negative results are retained.

reward_terms.name: object
reward_terms.formula: 10 exp(-||ball-reference_ball||²/.07²)

reward_terms.name: wrist_position
reward_terms.formula: .02*2 exp(-position_error²/.035²)

reward_terms.name: wrist_rotation
reward_terms.formula: .02 exp(-orientation_error²/.35²)

reward_terms.name: retention
reward_terms.formula: 2 exp(-||wrist_local_ball-initial_local_ball||²/.07²) outside flight

reward_terms.name: contact
reward_terms.formula: .5 when held phase and actual contact

reward_terms.name: spin
reward_terms.formula: 2 clipped relative angular velocity along palm normal /8 during spin windows

reward_terms.name: launch
reward_terms.formula: 2 clipped positive vertical ball velocity /2 within .12s of demonstrated launches

reward_terms.name: separation
reward_terms.formula: .5 for no hand contact inside demonstrated flight window

reward_terms.name: action
reward_terms.formula: -.02 mean(action²)

reward_terms.name: hardware
reward_terms.formula: -.02*20 max(0,max_speed_ratio-.8)²

reward_terms.name: failure
reward_terms.formula: -100 terminal event

reward_terms.name: ppo_scaling
reward_terms.formula: Multiply total by .05 for optimization; CSV reward is scaled; term columns are unscaled physical reward terms

reward_terms.name: task_progress
reward_terms.formula: 80 qualifying toss,120 stable catch,80 relative spin,150 final hold in order; 8 times new peak flight rise and 3 times signed spin-angle potential difference. Hidden reward state uses criteria v1 thresholds, not an actor input.

reward_terms.name: dense_rate_integration
reward_terms.formula: All dense object/retention/contact/angular-speed/launch/separation/action rates multiplied by .02 seconds. Task progression and failure are discrete. Positive progress multiplied by .2 when running wrist RMS>.07m or>25deg.

policy.closed_loop: RL actor observes encoder noise, actual wrist state and privileged ball state every 20ms. Network residual is added to the recorded anatomical/wrist reference, then executed by 500Hz commands and 1kHz hardware PD. No object action, attachment or ball reset after initial state.
policy.sensor_limitation: Exact simulator object pose/velocity; no tactile/force/current input.

episodes.initial_conditions: Frame-0 retargeted grasp with ball offsets +/-2mm XY +/-1mm Z, mass +/-5%, friction +/-10%, uniform random ball orientation; encoder noise as specified.

limitations: Agent-defined criteria v1, not official evaluation.
Privileged exact ball-state sensing; no real-world transfer shown.
The same 20 fixed seeds are reused for comparison and selection, not an independent held-out test.
Convex collision hulls and inferred rigid-pad contact properties.
Reference camera focal is prior-driven; human spin angle not observable.
No successful episode is claimed when none satisfies every ordered outcome.

body.selection_reason: Final comparison across seven evaluated RL iterations: highest mean ordered-stage count among episodes passing both finger hardware and wrist similarity; all complete-task success counts remain zero.
body.additional_evidence: Deterministic replay of existing seed1003 (not a new statistical sample) shows two ordered tosses, one catch and one relative spin; hardware and wrist criteria pass; full task still fails.

additional_evidence_metrics.note: Deterministic replay of existing evaluation seed1003 for evidence; not an additional statistical sample or a full-task success.

body.text: Research verdict: no evaluated RL policy reproduces the complete task under unchanged agent criteria v1. Seven iterations trained 6,012,928 policy decisions. Iteration4 is selected for mean ordered progress in hardware-and-wrist-compliant episodes; its final selection verdict is r0032. Iteration6 seed1019 completes three tosses/catches/turns but fails final hold and wrist RMS (76.6mm>70mm). Five counterfactual final-target holds also fail and are rejected. Reconstruction r0003 is VALID with documented warnings; all iterations, curves, videos, weights and negative verdicts are preserved. Remaining gap: stable final capture/hold and reliable composition while matching the wrist. This is my simulation claim, not an official evaluation or real-world result.
